source: three token shapes Jun defined (2026-10-26). output_share_of_all is fixed at 0.64%, the pooled measured output share of all tokens (usage.json, 2026-10-27); cache write is zero in every shape, as measured.

shapes.label: Cache-heavy (97%)
shapes.description: 97% of prompt tokens are cache reads: long agent sessions that reuse their context

shapes.label: Agent (80%)

shapes.label: Cold (0%)
